from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field


class StrictModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


class Provenance(StrictModel):
    site_id: str
    url: str
    title: str
    frame_path: str = "frame/0"
    snippet: str = Field(max_length=300)
    observed_at: datetime
    agent: str


class TenderInfo(StrictModel):
    reference: str
    title: str = ""
    buyer: str = ""
    deadline_raw: str = ""
    deadline_utc: datetime | None = None
    bidder_domain: str | None = None


class TenderPosition(StrictModel):
    position_id: str
    description: str
    quantity: Decimal = Field(gt=0)
    unit: Literal["piece", "set"]
    requirement_ref: str


class QAEntry(StrictModel):
    number: str
    date: datetime
    kind: Literal["quantity_change", "withdrawal", "technical_amendment", "condition_group", "packaging_tariff_key", "delivery_commitment_key", "setup_pool_membership", "bonus_membership", "other"]
    position_id: str | None = None
    payload: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)
    withdraws_number: str | None = None
    revision_ref: str | None = None
    requirement_ref: str | None = None


class Requirement(StrictModel):
    requirement_id: str
    katalog_group: str
    bore: Decimal
    stroke: Decimal
    stroke_kind: Literal["nominal", "usable"] = "nominal"
    pressure: Decimal
    mounting: str
    certification: str
    pieces_per_set: Decimal | None = None


class SpecRevision(StrictModel):
    revision_id: str
    status: Literal["current", "superseded", "unknown"]
    date: datetime | None = None
    requirements: list[Requirement]


class Material(StrictModel):
    number: str
    status: Literal["active", "blocked", "other"]
    katalog_group: str
    bore: Decimal
    stroke: Decimal
    pressure: Decimal
    mounting: str
    certification: str
    stock_qty: Decimal | None = None
    lead_weeks_stock: int | None = None
    lead_weeks_production: int | None = None
    carton_size: Decimal | None = None
    surcharge_mass: Decimal | None = None
    allocation_mass: Decimal | None = None
    setup_fee: Decimal | None = None
    surcharge_index: str | None = None
    surcharge_rate: Decimal | None = None
    surcharge_formula: dict | None = None


class PriceScale(StrictModel):
    min_qty: Decimal
    price: Decimal


class PriceCondition(StrictModel):
    material: str
    valid_from: str
    valid_to: str
    currency: str
    fx_key: str | None = None
    price_unit_qty: Decimal = Field(gt=0)
    scales: list[PriceScale]


class MailRecord(StrictModel):
    message_id: str
    folder: str
    sender: str
    date: datetime
    subject: str
    reference: str
    kind: Literal["discount_approval", "konditionsregeln", "technikfreigabe", "verpackungstarife", "terminfreigabe", "devisenfixing", "ruestpools", "projektbonus", "preisindizes", "other"]
    payload: dict
    raw_text: str = ""
    confidence: Literal["high", "low"] = "high"


class SearchCoverage(StrictModel):
    katalog_group: str
    complete: bool
    candidate_materials: list[str]


class TAN(StrictModel):
    value: str
    reference: str | None = None
    request_id: str | None = None
    requested_at: datetime | None = None
    requested_at_precision: Literal["second", "minute"] = "second"
    expires_at: datetime | None = None


RECORD_TYPES = {cls.__name__: cls for cls in (TenderInfo, TenderPosition, QAEntry, SpecRevision, Material, PriceCondition, MailRecord, SearchCoverage, TAN)}


PAYLOAD_GUIDE = """
All dates need an explicit timezone; normalize technical length to mm, pressure
to bar and mass to kg, preserving source values in snippets. Monetary/quantity
values use decimal strings with '.' as decimal separator, no thousands marks.
QA payloads: quantity_change {quantity}; technical_amendment {attributes: {field:value}};
condition_group/packaging_tariff_key/delivery_commitment_key/setup_pool_membership/
bonus_membership {key}. For multiple positions, record one QAEntry per position.
MailRecord payloads (record candidate mails even when unauthorized or superseded):
discount_approval {percent, min_order_value?};
konditionsregeln {groups: {key: 'base_only'|'base_plus_surcharge'|'none'}};
technikfreigabe {reserves: [{revision, requirement, per_end}]};
verpackungstarife {tariffs: {key: decimal_eur_per_carton}};
terminfreigabe {commitments: {key: {material, lead_weeks, ceiling_qty}}};
devisenfixing {rates: {key: decimal_eur_per_currency_unit}};
ruestpools {pools: {key: {fee, tie_break: 'position_asc'|'position_desc', allocation: 'largest_remainder'}}};
projektbonus {positions: [position_id], bands: [{up_to: decimal|null, percent: decimal}]};
preisindizes {indices: {code: [{valid_from: date|null, valid_to: date|null, rate: decimal}]} }.
Material surcharge_formula can specify {kind:'mass_times_rate'|'mass_times_excess',
baseline: decimal, multiplier: decimal}. Record the exact formula's parameters;
do not silently infer an excess formula or floor unless text states it. Optional
{floor: decimal} floors the per-kg rate difference. Material surcharge_rate is
only for a directly stated fixed rate; otherwise record surcharge_index.
Set known absent setup_fee/surcharge_mass to decimal zero only when evidenced.
SearchCoverage: complete=true only after inspecting all candidates in the
model-selected catalogue group, including paging if present. Needed to prove
no matching active material. Do not infer no_bid from an unfinished search.
TAN values are ephemeral and should be recorded only when signing is requested.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import os
import time

from openai import AsyncOpenAI


class ModelClient:
    """One chat-completions interface for whichever model the configuration selects.

    The endpoint, key, model name, extra request parameters and prices all come from settings, so another
    OpenAI-compatible provider behind the run proxy needs configuration only.
    """

    def __init__(self, settings, bus):
        self.client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ[settings.model_base_url_env], api_key=os.environ[settings.model_api_key_env],
                                  timeout=settings.model_first_call_timeout_s, max_retries=0)
        self.settings = settings
        self.model = settings.model_name
        self.bus = bus
        self.semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(settings.model_concurrency)
        self.total_cost = 0.0
        self.answered = False

    async def complete(self, agent, messages, tools=None, max_tokens=3500):
        started = time.monotonic()
        kwargs = {"model": self.model, "messages": messages, "max_tokens": max_tokens, "temperature": 0.15}
        if tools:
            kwargs["tools"] = tools
            kwargs["tool_choice"] = "required"
        if self.settings.model_extra_body:
            kwargs["extra_body"] = self.settings.model_extra_body
        attempts = self.settings.model_retries + 1
        for attempt in range(1, attempts + 1):
            # A hosted model may need minutes to wake for its first answer; afterwards a silent call is a stuck one.
            limit = self.settings.model_call_timeout_s if self.answered else self.settings.model_first_call_timeout_s
            try:
                async with self.semaphore:
                    response = await asyncio.wait_for(self.client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs), limit)
                break
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                raise
            except Exception as error:
                self.bus.emit("model_retry", agent, {"model": self.model, "attempt": attempt, "of": attempts,
                                                     "waited": round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
                                                     "reason": f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}"})
                if attempt == attempts:
                    raise
                await asyncio.sleep(min(2 ** attempt, 6))
        self.answered = True
        usage = response.usage
        counts = usage.model_dump() if usage else {}
        cached = (counts.get("prompt_tokens_details") or {}).get("cached_tokens", 0) or 0
        reasoning = (counts.get("completion_tokens_details") or {}).get("reasoning_tokens", 0) or 0
        inputs, outputs = counts.get("prompt_tokens", 0), counts.get("completion_tokens", 0)
        prices = self.settings.model_prices
        cost = ((inputs - cached) * prices["input"] + cached * prices["cached"] + outputs * prices["output"]) / 1e6
        self.total_cost += cost
        self.bus.emit("model_call", agent, {"model": self.model, "tokens_in": inputs, "tokens_cached": cached,
                                             "tokens_out": outputs, "tokens_reasoning": reasoning, "cost": cost,
                                             "latency": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)})
        return response.choices[0].message


QwenClient = ModelClient  # name used by development scripts

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import os
import time

from openai import AsyncOpenAI


class ModelClient:
    """One chat-completions interface for whichever model the configuration selects.

    The endpoint, key, model name, extra request parameters and prices all come from settings, so another
    OpenAI-compatible provider behind the run proxy needs configuration only.
    """

    def __init__(self, settings, bus):
        self.client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ[settings.model_base_url_env], api_key=os.environ[settings.model_api_key_env],
                                  timeout=settings.model_first_call_timeout_s, max_retries=0)
        self.settings = settings
        self.model = settings.model_name
        self.bus = bus
        self.semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(settings.model_concurrency)
        self.total_cost = 0.0
        self.answered = False

    async def complete(self, agent, messages, tools=None, max_tokens=3500):
        started = time.monotonic()
        kwargs = {"model": self.model, "messages": messages, "max_tokens": max_tokens, "temperature": 0.15}
        if tools:
            kwargs["tools"] = tools
            kwargs["tool_choice"] = "required"
        if self.settings.model_extra_body:
            kwargs["extra_body"] = self.settings.model_extra_body
        attempts = self.settings.model_retries + 1
        for attempt in range(1, attempts + 1):
            # A hosted model may need minutes to wake for its first answer; afterwards a silent call is a stuck one.
            limit = self.settings.model_call_timeout_s if self.answered else self.settings.model_first_call_timeout_s
            try:
                async with self.semaphore:
                    response = await asyncio.wait_for(self.client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs), limit)
                break
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                raise
            except Exception as error:
                self.bus.emit("model_retry", agent, {"model": self.model, "attempt": attempt, "of": attempts,
                                                     "waited": round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
                                                     "reason": f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}"})
                if attempt == attempts:
                    raise
                await asyncio.sleep(min(2 ** attempt, 6))
        self.answered = True
        usage = response.usage
        counts = usage.model_dump() if usage else {}
        cached = (counts.get("prompt_tokens_details") or {}).get("cached_tokens", 0) or 0
        reasoning = (counts.get("completion_tokens_details") or {}).get("reasoning_tokens", 0) or 0
        inputs, outputs = counts.get("prompt_tokens", 0), counts.get("completion_tokens", 0)
        prices = self.settings.model_prices
        cost = ((inputs - cached) * prices["input"] + cached * prices["cached"] + outputs * prices["output"]) / 1e6
        self.total_cost += cost
        self.bus.emit("model_call", agent, {"model": self.model, "tokens_in": inputs, "tokens_cached": cached,
                                             "tokens_out": outputs, "tokens_reasoning": reasoning, "cost": cost,
                                             "latency": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)})
        return response.choices[0].message

import tempfile
from dataclasses import dataclass

from typing import Mapping


def _checkout_root() -> Path:
    package = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    return package.parent if (package.parent / ".git").exists() else package


def _default_data_dir() -> Path:
    configured = os.environ.get("RFQ_DATA_DIR")
    if configured:
        return Path(configured).expanduser()
    base = Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA") or tempfile.gettempdir())
    return base / "atira-rfq" / "runs"

            try:
                decoded = json.loads(raw_scouting)

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

PACKAGE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "my-agent"
sys.path.insert(0, str(PACKAGE))

from rfq.llm.clients import ModelClient  # noqa: E402

REPLY = {"id": "synthetic", "object": "chat.completion", "created": 0, "model": "synthetic-model", "choices": [
    {"index": 0, "finish_reason": "stop", "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "synthetic answer"}}],
    "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 1000, "completion_tokens": 100, "total_tokens": 1100,
              "prompt_tokens_details": {"cached_tokens": 400}}}


class Bus:
    def __init__(self):
        self.events = []

    def emit(self, kind, agent, data):
        self.events.append((kind, agent, data))


class StalledThenAnswering(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    """A model endpoint that leaves its first requests unanswered, then answers normally."""

    async def serve(self, silent_requests):
        self.requests = 0
        self.held = []

        async def handle(reader, writer):
            headers = await reader.readuntil(b"\r\n\r\n")
            length = int(next((line.split(b":")[1] for line in headers.split(b"\r\n")
                               if line.lower().startswith(b"content-length")), b"0"))
            await reader.readexactly(length)
            self.requests += 1
            if self.requests <= silent_requests:
                self.held.append(writer)  # keep the connection open and say nothing
                return
            body = json.dumps(REPLY).encode()
            writer.write(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\ncontent-type: application/json\r\ncontent-length: "
                         + str(len(body)).encode() + b"\r\nconnection: close\r\n\r\n" + body)
            await writer.drain()
            writer.close()

        server = await asyncio.start_server(handle, "127.0.0.1", 0)
        self.addAsyncCleanup(self.stop, server)
        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]}/v1"

    async def stop(self, server):
        for writer in self.held:
            writer.close()
        server.close()
        await server.wait_closed()

    def client(self, url, **overrides):
        settings = SimpleNamespace(model_name="synthetic-model", model_base_url_env="SYNTHETIC_URL",
                                   model_api_key_env="SYNTHETIC_KEY", model_extra_body={},
                                   model_prices={"input": 1.0, "cached": 0.1, "output": 2.0}, model_concurrency=4,
                                   model_call_timeout_s=1, model_first_call_timeout_s=1, model_retries=2)
        for name, value in overrides.items():
            setattr(settings, name, value)
        self.bus = Bus()
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"SYNTHETIC_URL": url, "SYNTHETIC_KEY": "synthetic-key"}):
            return ModelClient(settings, self.bus)

    async def test_a_silent_call_is_abandoned_and_sent_again(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(silent_requests=1))
        started = time.monotonic()

        reply = await model.complete("worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}])

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import os
import time

from openai import AsyncOpenAI


class ModelClient:
    """One chat-completions interface for whichever model the configuration selects.

    The endpoint, key, model name, extra request parameters and prices all come from settings, so another
    OpenAI-compatible provider behind the run proxy needs configuration only.
    """

    def __init__(self, settings, bus):
        self.client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ[settings.model_base_url_env], api_key=os.environ[settings.model_api_key_env],
                                  timeout=settings.model_first_call_timeout_s, max_retries=0)
        self.settings = settings
        self.model = settings.model_name
        self.bus = bus
        self.semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(settings.model_concurrency)
        self.total_cost = 0.0
        self.answered = False

    async def complete(self, agent, messages, tools=None, max_tokens=3500):
        started = time.monotonic()
        kwargs = {"model": self.model, "messages": messages, "max_tokens": max_tokens, "temperature": 0.15}
        if tools:
            kwargs["tools"] = tools
            kwargs["tool_choice"] = "required"
        if self.settings.model_extra_body:
            kwargs["extra_body"] = self.settings.model_extra_body
        attempts = self.settings.model_retries + 1
        for attempt in range(1, attempts + 1):
            # A hosted model may need minutes to wake for its first answer; afterwards a silent call is a stuck one.
            limit = self.settings.model_call_timeout_s if self.answered else self.settings.model_first_call_timeout_s
            try:
                async with self.semaphore:
                    response = await asyncio.wait_for(self.client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs), limit)
                break
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                raise
            except Exception as error:
                self.bus.emit("model_retry", agent, {"model": self.model, "attempt": attempt, "of": attempts,
                                                     "waited": round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
                                                     "reason": f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}"})
                if attempt == attempts:
                    raise
                await asyncio.sleep(min(2 ** attempt, 6))
        self.answered = True
        usage = response.usage
        counts = usage.model_dump() if usage else {}
        cached = (counts.get("prompt_tokens_details") or {}).get("cached_tokens", 0) or 0
        reasoning = (counts.get("completion_tokens_details") or {}).get("reasoning_tokens", 0) or 0
        inputs, outputs = counts.get("prompt_tokens", 0), counts.get("completion_tokens", 0)
        prices = self.settings.model_prices
        cost = ((inputs - cached) * prices["input"] + cached * prices["cached"] + outputs * prices["output"]) / 1e6
        self.total_cost += cost
        self.bus.emit("model_call", agent, {"model": self.model, "tokens_in": inputs, "tokens_cached": cached,
                                             "tokens_out": outputs, "tokens_reasoning": reasoning, "cost": cost,
                                             "latency": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)})
        return response.choices[0].message

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

PACKAGE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "my-agent"
sys.path.insert(0, str(PACKAGE))

from rfq.llm.clients import ModelClient  # noqa: E402

REPLY = {"id": "synthetic", "object": "chat.completion", "created": 0, "model": "synthetic-model", "choices": [
    {"index": 0, "finish_reason": "stop", "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "synthetic answer"}}],
    "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 1000, "completion_tokens": 100, "total_tokens": 1100,
              "prompt_tokens_details": {"cached_tokens": 400}}}


class Bus:
    def __init__(self):
        self.events = []

    def emit(self, kind, agent, data):
        self.events.append((kind, agent, data))


class StalledThenAnswering(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    """A model endpoint that leaves its first requests unanswered, then answers normally."""

    async def serve(self, silent_requests):
        self.requests = 0
        self.held = []

        async def handle(reader, writer):
            headers = await reader.readuntil(b"\r\n\r\n")
            length = int(next((line.split(b":")[1] for line in headers.split(b"\r\n")
                               if line.lower().startswith(b"content-length")), b"0"))
            await reader.readexactly(length)
            self.requests += 1
            if self.requests <= silent_requests:
                self.held.append(writer)  # keep the connection open and say nothing
                return
            body = json.dumps(REPLY).encode()
            writer.write(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\ncontent-type: application/json\r\ncontent-length: "
                         + str(len(body)).encode() + b"\r\nconnection: close\r\n\r\n" + body)
            await writer.drain()
            writer.close()

        server = await asyncio.start_server(handle, "127.0.0.1", 0)
        self.addAsyncCleanup(self.stop, server)
        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]}/v1"

    async def stop(self, server):
        for writer in self.held:
            writer.close()
        server.close()
        await server.wait_closed()

    def client(self, url, **overrides):
        settings = SimpleNamespace(model_name="synthetic-model", model_base_url_env="SYNTHETIC_URL",
                                   model_api_key_env="SYNTHETIC_KEY", model_extra_body={},
                                   model_prices={"input": 1.0, "cached": 0.1, "output": 2.0}, model_concurrency=4,
                                   model_call_timeout_s=1, model_first_call_timeout_s=1, model_retries=2)
        for name, value in overrides.items():
            setattr(settings, name, value)
        self.bus = Bus()
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"SYNTHETIC_URL": url, "SYNTHETIC_KEY": "synthetic-key"}):
            return ModelClient(settings, self.bus)

    async def test_a_silent_call_is_abandoned_and_sent_again(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(silent_requests=1))
        started = time.monotonic()

        reply = await model.complete("worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}])

        self.assertEqual(reply.content, "synthetic answer")
        self.assertEqual(self.requests, 2)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 8)
        retries = [data for kind, _, data in self.bus.events if kind == "model_retry"]
        self.assertEqual([(r["attempt"], r["of"]) for r in retries], [(1, 3)])
        [call] = [data for kind, _, data in self.bus.events if kind == "model_call"]
        # 600 fresh input, 400 cached, 100 output at the configured prices per million tokens
        self.assertAlmostEqual(call["cost"], (600 * 1.0 + 400 * 0.1 + 100 * 2.0) / 1e6)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.total_cost, call["cost"])

    async def test_an_endpoint_that_never_answers_fails_within_the_bound(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(silent_requests=99), model_retries=1)
        started = time.monotonic()

        with self.assertRaises(Exception):
            await model.complete("worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}])

        self.assertEqual(self.requests, 2)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 8)
        self.assertEqual(len([1 for kind, _, _ in self.bus.events if kind == "model_retry"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(model.total_cost, 0.0)

    async def test_only_the_first_answer_gets_the_long_wake_up_allowance(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(silent_requests=0), model_first_call_timeout_s=30, model_call_timeout_s=1)
        await model.complete("worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}])
        self.assertTrue(model.answered)
        self.requests = -1  # the next request is left unanswered once

        started = time.monotonic()
        await model.complete("worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}])

        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 8)

    async def test_configured_extra_parameters_reach_the_endpoint(self):
        seen = {}
        original = ModelClient.complete

        model = self.client(await self.serve(silent_requests=0), model_extra_body={"synthetic_switch": {"mode": "plain"}})
        create = model.client.chat.completions.create

        async def recording(**kwargs):
            seen.update(kwargs)
            return await create(**kwargs)
        model.client.chat.completions.create = recording

        await original(model, "worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}])

        self.assertEqual(seen["extra_body"], {"synthetic_switch": {"mode": "plain"}})
        self.assertEqual(seen["model"], "synthetic-model")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import re
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


def _origin(url):
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    return f"{parts.scheme}://{parts.netloc}"


# Generic wording of transient server failures and of a retry control, in the languages the sites may use.
TEMPORARY_FAILURE = re.compile(
    r"service unavailable|bad gateway|gateway time-?out|temporarily unavailable|try again later"
    r"|vor[uü]bergehend nicht verf[uü]gbar|derzeit nicht verf[uü]gbar|zurzeit nicht verf[uü]gbar"
    r"|sp[aä]ter erneut versuchen", re.I)
RETRY_CONTROL = re.compile(r"^\s*(erneut versuchen|nochmals? versuchen|wiederholen|retry|try again)\s*$", re.I)


def temporary_failure(text: str) -> bool:
    """A short page that only reports a transient failure, not a working page that mentions one."""
    return len(text) < 1500 and bool(TEMPORARY_FAILURE.search(text))


async def consent(session):
    """Dismiss generic cookie consent using only consent-related page text."""
    for frame in session.page.frames:
        try:
            text = await frame.locator("body").inner_text(timeout=800)
            if len(text) > 3500 or not re.search(r"cookie|cookies|datenschutz|consent", text, re.I):
                continue
            button = frame.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile(r"(?:notwendige|necessary|essential).*cookies.*(?:akzeptieren|accept)|(?:alle akzeptieren|accept all|zustimmen)", re.I))
            if await button.count() == 1 and await button.is_visible():
                await button.click(timeout=3500)
                session.notices.append("Generic cookie consent accepted.")
                return
        except Exception:
            pass


async def login(session) -> str:
    """Fill a model-selected login form using generic credential field types."""
    for frame in session.page.frames:
        passwords = frame.locator('input[type="password"]:visible')
        if not await passwords.count():
            continue
        # An assigned worker may follow evidence to another run-provided site.
        site = getattr(session, "sites_by_origin", {}).get(_origin(frame.url),
                getattr(session, "current_site", session.site))
        credentials = site.get("credentials") or {}
        form = passwords.first.locator("xpath=ancestor::form[1]")
        scope = form if await form.count() else frame
        users = scope.locator('input:not([type="password"]):not([type="hidden"]):not([type="submit"]):not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"]):not([readonly]):not([disabled]):visible')
        if not await users.count():
            return "Login needs a username field selected explicitly."
        await users.first.fill(credentials.get("username", ""))
        await passwords.first.fill(credentials.get("password", ""))
        await passwords.first.press("Enter")

    return "No visible password form found."

    """Replace a tab that stopped responding with a fresh one at the last working address."""
    stuck = session.page
    session.page = await session.context.new_page()
    session.install_handlers(session.page)
    target = session.last_good_urls.get(_origin(session.last_good_url), session.last_good_url) or session.site["url"]
    try:
        await session.page.goto(target, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=15000)
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:

        await asyncio.wait_for(stuck.close(), 3)

        pass
    session.notices.append("The previous tab stopped responding and was replaced; unsaved entries in it are lost.")
    if bus:
        bus.emit("retry", agent, {"reason": "unresponsive tab replaced"})

    current_origin = _origin(session.page.url)
    previous = getattr(session, "last_good_urls", {}).get(current_origin)
    if not previous and _origin(session.last_good_url) == current_origin:
        previous = session.last_good_url
    if previous:
        for frame in session.page.frames:
            if await frame.locator('input[type="password"]:visible').count():

                try:

                except Exception:
                    pass
                session.notices.append("Session renewal attempted: " + message)
                break
    else:
        # The model initiates first login; it sees consent walls in the DOM.
        return

import asyncio
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


def origin(url: str) -> str:
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    return f"{parts.scheme}://{parts.netloc}"


@dataclass
class BrowserSession:
    browser: object
    context: object
    page: object
    site: dict
    allowed_origins: set[str]
    elements: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    notices: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    dialogs: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    confirm_final: bool = False
    last_good_url: str = ""
    last_snapshot: object = None
    nav_hashes: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    local: bool = False
    request_factory: object = None
    sites_by_origin: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    last_good_urls: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    opening_own_tab: bool = False

    @property
    def current_site(self):
        return self.sites_by_origin.get(origin(self.page.url), self.site)

    def install_handlers(self, page):
        page.set_default_timeout(7000)
        async def dialog_handler(dialog):
            self.dialogs.append(dialog.message)
            if self.confirm_final:
                await dialog.accept()
            else:
                await dialog.dismiss()
                self.notices.append("Dialog dismissed without final-confirm authority: " + dialog.message)
        page.on("dialog", dialog_handler)

    async def new_tab(self):
        """Open a tab of the session's own, which is not a popup of the website."""
        self.opening_own_tab = True
        try:
            page = await self.context.new_page()
        finally:
            self.opening_own_tab = False
        self.install_handlers(page)
        return page

    async def capture_popup(self, page):
        if self.opening_own_tab:
            return
        self.install_handlers(page)
        try:
            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=4000)
            content = await page.locator("body").inner_text(timeout=1500)
            self.notices.append("Popup: " + content[:6000])
        except Exception:
            self.notices.append("Popup opened and may have closed; inspect tabs or originating page.")

    @classmethod
    async def connect(cls, playwright, settings, site: dict, index: int, sites: list[dict]):
        if settings.cdp_urls:
            if index >= len(settings.cdp_urls):
                raise ValueError("Insufficient platform browsers for site workers")
            browser = await playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp(settings.cdp_urls[index])
            context = browser.contexts[0] if browser.contexts else await browser.new_context()
        else:
            browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=settings.headless)
            context = await browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 800}, accept_downloads=True)
        page = context.pages[0] if context.pages else await context.new_page()
        page.set_default_timeout(7000)
        session = cls(browser, context, page, site, {origin(s["url"]) for s in sites}, local=not settings.cdp_urls)
        session.request_factory = playwright.request
        session.sites_by_origin = {origin(s["url"]): s for s in sites}
        session.install_handlers(page)
        # The run assigns an entry site, not an investigation path.
        await session.open_entry()
        context.on("page", lambda popup: asyncio.create_task(session.capture_popup(popup)))
        return session

    async def open_entry(self, attempts: int = 4, limit_ms: int = 12000):
        """Load the entry site, on a fresh tab after each attempt that gets no answer.

        A request can occasionally be left without any response while the site serves others normally, and the
        tab that made it stays unusable. One such request must not end the run before it starts.
        """
        for attempt in range(1, attempts + 1):
            try:
                await self.page.goto(self.site["url"], wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=limit_ms)
                return
            except Exception:
                if attempt == attempts:
                    raise
                stuck, self.page = self.page, await self.new_tab()
                try:
                    await asyncio.wait_for(stuck.close(), 3)
                except Exception:
                    pass

    async def close(self):
        if self.local:
            await self.browser.close()

Uses a prompt of realistic size (the run brief plus filler) with a tool, several concurrent workers as in a run.
"""
import asyncio
import json
import pathlib
import sys
import time

from openai import AsyncOpenAI

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
env = json.loads((HERE.parent / "scout_env.json").read_text())
brief = json.loads((HERE.parent / "scouting.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["brief"]
client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=env["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=env["QWEN_API_KEY"], timeout=120, max_retries=0)
rounds = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 4
workers = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 4
tool = {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "browser", "description": "Act on the page.", "parameters": {
    "type": "object", "properties": {"kind": {"type": "string"}, "id": {"type": "integer"},
                                     "actions": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object"}},
                                     "reason": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["reason"]}}}


async def one(worker, round_no):
    filler = "\n".join(f"[{i}] link synthetic row {worker}-{round_no}-{i}" for i in range(1, 120))
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": "You are a browser agent. Choose one tool call.\n" + brief},
                {"role": "user", "content": f"Observation:\n{filler}\nTask: open synthetic row {worker}-{round_no}-57."}]
    started = time.monotonic()
    first = last = None
    gaps, chunks, usage, finish = [], 0, None, None
    name, arguments, content, reasoning = "", "", "", 0
    try:
        stream = await client.chat.completions.create(model="qwen", messages=messages, tools=[tool], tool_choice="required",
                                                      max_tokens=1500, temperature=0.15, stream=True,
                                                      stream_options={"include_usage": True})
        async for chunk in stream:
            now = time.monotonic()
            if first is None:
                first = now - started
            else:
                gaps.append(now - last)
            last = now
            chunks += 1
            if chunk.usage:
                usage = chunk.usage.model_dump()
            for choice in chunk.choices:
                finish = choice.finish_reason or finish
                delta = choice.delta
                content += delta.content or ""
                extra = delta.model_extra or {}
                reasoning += len(extra.get("reasoning_content") or extra.get("reasoning") or "")
                for call in delta.tool_calls or []:
                    name += call.function.name or ""
                    arguments += call.function.arguments or ""
    except Exception as error:
        return f"w{worker} r{round_no}: FAIL after {time.monotonic() - started:5.1f}s first_chunk={first} {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]}"
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(arguments)
        valid = "valid-json" if parsed.get("id") == 57 or parsed.get("actions") else "valid-json(other target)"
    except ValueError:
        valid = "INVALID-ARGS"
    cached = ((usage or {}).get("prompt_tokens_details") or {}).get("cached_tokens")
    return (f"w{worker} r{round_no}: total {time.monotonic() - started:5.1f}s first_chunk {first:5.2f}s max_gap {max(gaps) if gaps else 0:4.2f}s "
            f"chunks {chunks:3} finish={finish} tool={name} {valid} reasoning_chars={reasoning} "
            f"usage={'in=%s out=%s cached=%s' % (usage.get('prompt_tokens'), usage.get('completion_tokens'), cached) if usage else 'MISSING'}")


async def main():
    for round_no in range(1, rounds + 1):
        for line in await asyncio.gather(*(one(w, round_no) for w in range(1, workers + 1))):
            print(line, flush=True)


asyncio.run(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import os
import time

from openai import AsyncOpenAI
from openai.types.chat import ChatCompletionMessage


class ModelClient:
    """One chat-completions interface for whichever model the configuration selects.

    The endpoint, key, model name, extra request parameters and prices all come from settings, so another
    OpenAI-compatible provider behind the run proxy needs configuration only.

    A request is occasionally left without any response while the service answers others normally. Answers are
    therefore read as a stream: a healthy call starts within a couple of seconds, so one that has sent nothing
    after a short limit is abandoned and sent again instead of being waited on.
    """

    def __init__(self, settings, bus):
        self.client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ[settings.model_base_url_env], api_key=os.environ[settings.model_api_key_env],
                                  timeout=settings.model_first_call_timeout_s, max_retries=0)
        self.settings = settings
        self.model = settings.model_name
        self.bus = bus
        self.semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(settings.model_concurrency)
        self.total_cost = 0.0
        self.answered = False

    async def complete(self, agent, messages, tools=None, max_tokens=3500):
        started = time.monotonic()
        kwargs = {"model": self.model, "messages": messages, "max_tokens": max_tokens, "temperature": 0.15}
        if tools:
            kwargs["tools"] = tools
            kwargs["tool_choice"] = "required"
        if self.settings.model_extra_body:
            kwargs["extra_body"] = self.settings.model_extra_body
        attempts = self.settings.model_retries + 1
        attempt = 0
        while True:
            attempt += 1
            try:
                async with self.semaphore:
                    message, usage, finish = await (self.streamed(kwargs) if self.settings.model_stream else self.whole(kwargs))
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                raise
            except Exception as error:
                self.bus.emit("model_retry", agent, {"model": self.model, "attempt": attempt, "of": attempts,
                                                     "waited": round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
                                                     "reason": f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}"})
                if attempt >= attempts:
                    raise
                await asyncio.sleep(min(attempt, 4))
                continue
            self.answered = True
            self.account(agent, usage, finish, started)
            # Reasoning counts against the output allowance, so a cut-off answer can be empty or half a tool call.
            if finish == "length" and attempt < attempts:
                kwargs["max_tokens"] = min(kwargs["max_tokens"] * 2, 12000)
                self.bus.emit("model_retry", agent, {"model": self.model, "attempt": attempt, "of": attempts,
                                                     "reason": "answer cut off at the output allowance",
                                                     "next_max_tokens": kwargs["max_tokens"]})
                continue
            return message

    def wake_allowance(self, usual):

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

PACKAGE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "my-agent"
sys.path.insert(0, str(PACKAGE))

from rfq.llm.clients import ModelClient  # noqa: E402

USAGE = {"prompt_tokens": 1000, "completion_tokens": 100, "total_tokens": 1100,
         "prompt_tokens_details": {"cached_tokens": 400}}
COST = (600 * 1.0 + 400 * 0.1 + 100 * 2.0) / 1e6  # at the synthetic prices configured below


def chunk(delta=None, finish=None, usage=None):
    body = {"id": "synthetic", "object": "chat.completion.chunk", "created": 0, "model": "synthetic-model",
            "choices": [] if delta is None and finish is None else [{"index": 0, "delta": delta or {}, "finish_reason": finish}]}
    if usage:
        body["usage"] = usage
    return body


ANSWER = [chunk({"role": "assistant", "content": "synthetic "}), chunk({"content": "answer"}), chunk({}, "stop"), chunk(usage=USAGE)]
CUT_OFF = [chunk({"role": "assistant", "content": None}), chunk({}, "length"), chunk(usage=USAGE)]
TOOL_CALL = [
    chunk({"role": "assistant", "tool_calls": [{"index": 0, "id": "call_synthetic", "type": "function",
                                                "function": {"name": "browser", "arguments": ""}}]}),
    chunk({"tool_calls": [{"index": 0, "function": {"arguments": '{"actions": [{"kind": "cli'}}]}),
    chunk({"tool_calls": [{"index": 0, "function": {"arguments": 'ck", "id": 7}], "reason": "synthetic"}'}}]}),
    chunk({"tool_calls": [{"index": 1, "id": "call_second", "type": "function",
                           "function": {"name": "record", "arguments": '{"kind": "Synthetic"}'}}]}),
    chunk({}, "tool_calls"), chunk(usage=USAGE)]


class Bus:
    def __init__(self):
        self.events = []

    def emit(self, kind, agent, data):
        self.events.append((kind, agent, data))

    def of(self, kind):
        return [data for name, _, data in self.events if name == kind]


class ModelEndpoint(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    """A stand-in model endpoint whose successive requests behave as scripted."""

    async def serve(self, *script):
        """Each script entry handles one request: 'silent', 'half' (starts, then stops sending) or a chunk list."""
        self.script = list(script)
        self.requests = []
        self.held = []

        async def handle(reader, writer):
            headers = await reader.readuntil(b"\r\n\r\n")
            length = int(next((line.split(b":")[1] for line in headers.split(b"\r\n")
                               if line.lower().startswith(b"content-length")), b"0"))
            request = json.loads(await reader.readexactly(length))
            self.requests.append(request)
            plan = self.script[min(len(self.requests), len(self.script)) - 1]
            if plan == "silent":
                self.held.append(writer)  # connection accepted, nothing ever sent
                return
            chunks = ANSWER if plan == "half" else plan
            if not request.get("stream"):
                text = "".join(c["choices"][0]["delta"].get("content") or "" for c in chunks if c["choices"])
                finish = next(c["choices"][0]["finish_reason"] for c in chunks if c["choices"] and c["choices"][0]["finish_reason"])
                body = json.dumps({"id": "synthetic", "object": "chat.completion", "created": 0, "model": "synthetic-model",
                                   "choices": [{"index": 0, "finish_reason": finish,
                                                "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": text or None}}],
                                   "usage": USAGE}).encode()
                writer.write(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\ncontent-type: application/json\r\ncontent-length: "
                             + str(len(body)).encode() + b"\r\nconnection: close\r\n\r\n" + body)
                await writer.drain()
                writer.close()
                return
            writer.write(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\ncontent-type: text/event-stream\r\nconnection: close\r\n\r\n")
            for position, part in enumerate(chunks):
                writer.write(b"data: " + json.dumps(part).encode() + b"\n\n")
                await writer.drain()
                if plan == "half" and position == 0:
                    self.held.append(writer)  # the answer began and then went quiet
                    return
            writer.write(b"data: [DONE]\n\n")
            await writer.drain()
            writer.close()

        server = await asyncio.start_server(handle, "127.0.0.1", 0)
        self.addAsyncCleanup(self.stop, server)
        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]}/v1"

    async def stop(self, server):
        for writer in self.held:
            writer.close()
        server.close()
        await server.wait_closed()

    def client(self, url, **overrides):
        settings = SimpleNamespace(model_name="synthetic-model", model_base_url_env="SYNTHETIC_URL",
                                   model_api_key_env="SYNTHETIC_KEY", model_extra_body={},
                                   model_prices={"input": 1.0, "cached": 0.1, "output": 2.0}, model_concurrency=4,
                                   model_stream=True, model_first_chunk_timeout_s=1, model_chunk_gap_timeout_s=1,
                                   model_call_timeout_s=6, model_first_call_timeout_s=1, model_retries=2)
        for name, value in overrides.items():
            setattr(settings, name, value)
        self.bus = Bus()
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"SYNTHETIC_URL": url, "SYNTHETIC_KEY": "synthetic-key"}):
            return ModelClient(settings, self.bus)

    async def ask(self, model, **kwargs):
        return await model.complete("worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}], **kwargs)

    async def test_a_streamed_answer_is_assembled_and_priced(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(ANSWER))

        reply = await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(reply.content, "synthetic answer")
        self.assertIsNone(reply.tool_calls)
        self.assertTrue(self.requests[0]["stream"])
        [call] = self.bus.of("model_call")
        self.assertEqual((call["finish"], call["tokens_in"], call["tokens_cached"], call["tokens_out"]), ("stop", 1000, 400, 100))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(call["cost"], COST)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.total_cost, COST)

    async def test_tool_calls_split_across_chunks_are_put_back_together(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(TOOL_CALL))

        reply = await self.ask(model, tools=[{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "browser", "parameters": {"type": "object"}}}])

        self.assertEqual([call.function.name for call in reply.tool_calls], ["browser", "record"])
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(reply.tool_calls[0].function.arguments),
                         {"actions": [{"kind": "click", "id": 7}], "reason": "synthetic"})
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(reply.tool_calls[1].function.arguments), {"kind": "Synthetic"})
        self.assertEqual(reply.tool_calls[0].id, "call_synthetic")
        self.assertEqual(self.requests[0]["tool_choice"], "required")

    async def test_a_call_that_sends_nothing_is_abandoned_quickly_and_sent_again(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve("silent", ANSWER))
        started = time.monotonic()

        reply = await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(reply.content, "synthetic answer")
        self.assertEqual(len(self.requests), 2)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 4)
        self.assertEqual([(r["attempt"], r["of"]) for r in self.bus.of("model_retry")], [(1, 3)])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.total_cost, COST)

    async def test_an_answer_that_starts_and_then_goes_quiet_is_sent_again(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve("half", ANSWER))
        started = time.monotonic()

        reply = await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(reply.content, "synthetic answer")  # not the fragment "synthetic " from the abandoned attempt
        self.assertEqual(len(self.requests), 2)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 5)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.bus.of("model_retry")), 1)

    async def test_an_endpoint_that_never_answers_fails_within_the_bound(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve("silent"), model_retries=1)
        started = time.monotonic()

        with self.assertRaises(Exception):
            await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(len(self.requests), 2)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 6)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.bus.of("model_retry")), 2)
        self.assertEqual(model.total_cost, 0.0)

    async def test_a_cut_off_answer_is_asked_again_with_a_larger_allowance_and_both_are_priced(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(CUT_OFF, ANSWER))

        reply = await self.ask(model, max_tokens=800)

        self.assertEqual(reply.content, "synthetic answer")
        self.assertEqual([request["max_tokens"] for request in self.requests], [800, 1600])
        self.assertEqual([call["finish"] for call in self.bus.of("model_call")], ["length", "stop"])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.total_cost, 2 * COST)

    async def test_an_answer_still_cut_off_after_the_last_attempt_is_returned_as_it_is(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(CUT_OFF), model_retries=1)

        reply = await self.ask(model, max_tokens=800)

        self.assertIsNone(reply.content)
        self.assertEqual([request["max_tokens"] for request in self.requests], [800, 1600])

    async def test_only_the_first_answer_gets_the_long_wake_up_allowance(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(ANSWER, "silent", ANSWER), model_first_call_timeout_s=30)
        await self.ask(model)
        self.assertTrue(model.answered)

        started = time.monotonic()
        await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(len(self.requests), 3)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 4)

    async def test_before_the_first_answer_a_slow_start_is_waited_for(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve("silent", ANSWER), model_first_call_timeout_s=3)
        started = time.monotonic()

        await self.ask(model)

        # The 1 s first-chunk limit does not apply yet: the silent first request is given the 3 s wake allowance.
        self.assertGreater(time.monotonic() - started, 2.9)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.requests), 2)

    async def test_configured_extra_parameters_reach_the_endpoint(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(ANSWER), model_extra_body={"synthetic_switch": {"mode": "plain"}})

        await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(self.requests[0]["synthetic_switch"], {"mode": "plain"})
        self.assertEqual(self.requests[0]["model"], "synthetic-model")

    async def test_a_provider_without_streaming_is_served_by_the_whole_answer_path(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve("silent", ANSWER), model_stream=False, model_call_timeout_s=1)

        reply = await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(reply.content, "synthetic answer")
        self.assertNotIn("stream", self.requests[1])
        self.assertEqual(len(self.bus.of("model_retry")), 1)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.total_cost, COST)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

PACKAGE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "my-agent"
sys.path.insert(0, str(PACKAGE))

from rfq.llm.clients import ModelClient  # noqa: E402

USAGE = {"prompt_tokens": 1000, "completion_tokens": 100, "total_tokens": 1100,
         "prompt_tokens_details": {"cached_tokens": 400}}
COST = (600 * 1.0 + 400 * 0.1 + 100 * 2.0) / 1e6  # at the synthetic prices configured below


def chunk(delta=None, finish=None, usage=None):
    body = {"id": "synthetic", "object": "chat.completion.chunk", "created": 0, "model": "synthetic-model",
            "choices": [] if delta is None and finish is None else [{"index": 0, "delta": delta or {}, "finish_reason": finish}]}
    if usage:
        body["usage"] = usage
    return body


ANSWER = [chunk({"role": "assistant", "content": "synthetic "}), chunk({"content": "answer"}), chunk({}, "stop"), chunk(usage=USAGE)]
CUT_OFF = [chunk({"role": "assistant", "content": None}), chunk({}, "length"), chunk(usage=USAGE)]
TOOL_CALL = [
    chunk({"role": "assistant", "tool_calls": [{"index": 0, "id": "call_synthetic", "type": "function",
                                                "function": {"name": "browser", "arguments": ""}}]}),
    chunk({"tool_calls": [{"index": 0, "function": {"arguments": '{"actions": [{"kind": "cli'}}]}),
    chunk({"tool_calls": [{"index": 0, "function": {"arguments": 'ck", "id": 7}], "reason": "synthetic"}'}}]}),
    chunk({"tool_calls": [{"index": 1, "id": "call_second", "type": "function",
                           "function": {"name": "record", "arguments": '{"kind": "Synthetic"}'}}]}),
    chunk({}, "tool_calls"), chunk(usage=USAGE)]


class Bus:
    def __init__(self):
        self.events = []

    def emit(self, kind, agent, data):
        self.events.append((kind, agent, data))

    def of(self, kind):
        return [data for name, _, data in self.events if name == kind]


class ModelEndpoint(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    """A stand-in model endpoint whose successive requests behave as scripted."""

    async def serve(self, *script):
        """Each script entry handles one request: 'silent', 'half' (starts, then stops sending) or a chunk list."""
        self.script = list(script)
        self.requests = []
        self.held = []

        async def handle(reader, writer):
            headers = await reader.readuntil(b"\r\n\r\n")
            length = int(next((line.split(b":")[1] for line in headers.split(b"\r\n")
                               if line.lower().startswith(b"content-length")), b"0"))
            request = json.loads(await reader.readexactly(length))
            self.requests.append(request)
            plan = self.script[min(len(self.requests), len(self.script)) - 1]
            if plan == "silent":
                self.held.append(writer)  # connection accepted, nothing ever sent
                return
            chunks = ANSWER if plan == "half" else plan
            if not request.get("stream"):
                text = "".join(c["choices"][0]["delta"].get("content") or "" for c in chunks if c["choices"])
                finish = next(c["choices"][0]["finish_reason"] for c in chunks if c["choices"] and c["choices"][0]["finish_reason"])
                body = json.dumps({"id": "synthetic", "object": "chat.completion", "created": 0, "model": "synthetic-model",
                                   "choices": [{"index": 0, "finish_reason": finish,
                                                "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": text or None}}],
                                   "usage": USAGE}).encode()
                writer.write(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\ncontent-type: application/json\r\ncontent-length: "
                             + str(len(body)).encode() + b"\r\nconnection: close\r\n\r\n" + body)
                await writer.drain()
                writer.close()
                return
            writer.write(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\ncontent-type: text/event-stream\r\nconnection: close\r\n\r\n")
            for position, part in enumerate(chunks):
                writer.write(b"data: " + json.dumps(part).encode() + b"\n\n")
                await writer.drain()
                if plan == "half" and position == 0:
                    self.held.append(writer)  # the answer began and then went quiet
                    return
            writer.write(b"data: [DONE]\n\n")
            await writer.drain()
            writer.close()

        server = await asyncio.start_server(handle, "127.0.0.1", 0)
        self.addAsyncCleanup(self.stop, server)
        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]}/v1"

    async def stop(self, server):
        for writer in self.held:
            writer.close()
        server.close()
        await server.wait_closed()

    def client(self, url, **overrides):
        settings = SimpleNamespace(model_name="synthetic-model", model_base_url_env="SYNTHETIC_URL",
                                   model_api_key_env="SYNTHETIC_KEY", model_extra_body={},
                                   model_prices={"input": 1.0, "cached": 0.1, "output": 2.0}, model_concurrency=4,
                                   model_stream=True, model_first_chunk_timeout_s=1, model_chunk_gap_timeout_s=1,
                                   model_call_timeout_s=6, model_first_call_timeout_s=1, model_retries=2)
        for name, value in overrides.items():
            setattr(settings, name, value)
        self.bus = Bus()
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"SYNTHETIC_URL": url, "SYNTHETIC_KEY": "synthetic-key"}):
            return ModelClient(settings, self.bus)

    async def ask(self, model, **kwargs):
        return await model.complete("worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}], **kwargs)

    async def test_a_streamed_answer_is_assembled_and_priced(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(ANSWER))

        reply = await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(reply.content, "synthetic answer")
        self.assertIsNone(reply.tool_calls)
        self.assertTrue(self.requests[0]["stream"])
        [call] = self.bus.of("model_call")
        self.assertEqual((call["finish"], call["tokens_in"], call["tokens_cached"], call["tokens_out"]), ("stop", 1000, 400, 100))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(call["cost"], COST)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.total_cost, COST)

    async def test_tool_calls_split_across_chunks_are_put_back_together(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(TOOL_CALL))

        reply = await self.ask(model, tools=[{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "browser", "parameters": {"type": "object"}}}])

        self.assertEqual([call.function.name for call in reply.tool_calls], ["browser", "record"])
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(reply.tool_calls[0].function.arguments),
                         {"actions": [{"kind": "click", "id": 7}], "reason": "synthetic"})
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(reply.tool_calls[1].function.arguments), {"kind": "Synthetic"})
        self.assertEqual(reply.tool_calls[0].id, "call_synthetic")
        self.assertEqual(self.requests[0]["tool_choice"], "required")

    async def test_a_call_that_sends_nothing_is_abandoned_quickly_and_sent_again(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve("silent", ANSWER))
        started = time.monotonic()

        reply = await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(reply.content, "synthetic answer")
        self.assertEqual(len(self.requests), 2)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 4)
        self.assertEqual([(r["attempt"], r["of"]) for r in self.bus.of("model_retry")], [(1, 3)])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.total_cost, COST)

    async def test_an_answer_that_starts_and_then_goes_quiet_is_sent_again(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve("half", ANSWER))
        started = time.monotonic()

        reply = await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(reply.content, "synthetic answer")  # not the fragment "synthetic " from the abandoned attempt
        self.assertEqual(len(self.requests), 2)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 5)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.bus.of("model_retry")), 1)

    async def test_an_endpoint_that_never_answers_fails_within_the_bound(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve("silent"), model_retries=1)
        started = time.monotonic()

        with self.assertRaises(Exception):
            await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(len(self.requests), 2)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 6)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.bus.of("model_retry")), 2)
        self.assertEqual(model.total_cost, 0.0)

    async def test_a_cut_off_answer_is_asked_again_with_a_larger_allowance_and_both_are_priced(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(CUT_OFF, ANSWER))

        reply = await self.ask(model, max_tokens=800)

        self.assertEqual(reply.content, "synthetic answer")
        self.assertEqual([request["max_tokens"] for request in self.requests], [800, 1600])
        self.assertEqual([call["finish"] for call in self.bus.of("model_call")], ["length", "stop"])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.total_cost, 2 * COST)

    async def test_an_answer_still_cut_off_after_the_last_attempt_is_returned_as_it_is(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(CUT_OFF), model_retries=1)

        reply = await self.ask(model, max_tokens=800)

        self.assertIsNone(reply.content)
        self.assertEqual([request["max_tokens"] for request in self.requests], [800, 1600])

    async def test_only_the_first_answer_gets_the_long_wake_up_allowance(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(ANSWER, "silent", ANSWER), model_first_call_timeout_s=30)
        await self.ask(model)
        self.assertTrue(model.answered)

        started = time.monotonic()
        await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(len(self.requests), 3)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 4)

    async def test_before_the_first_answer_a_slow_start_is_waited_for(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve("silent", ANSWER), model_first_call_timeout_s=3)
        started = time.monotonic()

        await self.ask(model)

        # The 1 s first-chunk limit does not apply yet: the silent first request is given the 3 s wake allowance.
        self.assertGreater(time.monotonic() - started, 2.9)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.requests), 2)

    async def test_configured_extra_parameters_reach_the_endpoint(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(ANSWER), model_extra_body={"synthetic_switch": {"mode": "plain"}})

        await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(self.requests[0]["synthetic_switch"], {"mode": "plain"})
        self.assertEqual(self.requests[0]["model"], "synthetic-model")

    async def test_a_provider_without_streaming_is_served_by_the_whole_answer_path(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve("silent", ANSWER), model_stream=False, model_call_timeout_s=1)

        reply = await self.ask(model)

        self.assertEqual(reply.content, "synthetic answer")
        self.assertNotIn("stream", self.requests[1])
        self.assertEqual(len(self.bus.of("model_retry")), 1)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.total_cost, COST)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

PACKAGE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "my-agent"
sys.path.insert(0, str(PACKAGE))

from rfq.llm.clients import ModelClient  # noqa: E402

REPLY = {"id": "synthetic", "object": "chat.completion", "created": 0, "model": "synthetic-model", "choices": [
    {"index": 0, "finish_reason": "stop", "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "synthetic answer"}}],
    "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 1000, "completion_tokens": 100, "total_tokens": 1100,
              "prompt_tokens_details": {"cached_tokens": 400}}}


class Bus:
    def __init__(self):
        self.events = []

    def emit(self, kind, agent, data):
        self.events.append((kind, agent, data))


class StalledThenAnswering(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    """A model endpoint that leaves its first requests unanswered, then answers normally."""

    async def serve(self, silent_requests, cut_off_requests=0):
        self.requests = 0
        self.held = []
        self.allowances = []

        async def handle(reader, writer):
            headers = await reader.readuntil(b"\r\n\r\n")
            length = int(next((line.split(b":")[1] for line in headers.split(b"\r\n")
                               if line.lower().startswith(b"content-length")), b"0"))
            self.allowances.append(json.loads(await reader.readexactly(length)).get("max_tokens"))
            self.requests += 1
            if self.requests <= silent_requests:
                self.held.append(writer)  # keep the connection open and say nothing
                return
            reply = REPLY
            if self.requests <= silent_requests + cut_off_requests:
                reply = {**REPLY, "choices": [{"index": 0, "finish_reason": "length",
                                               "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": None}}]}
            body = json.dumps(reply).encode()
            writer.write(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\ncontent-type: application/json\r\ncontent-length: "
                         + str(len(body)).encode() + b"\r\nconnection: close\r\n\r\n" + body)
            await writer.drain()
            writer.close()

        server = await asyncio.start_server(handle, "127.0.0.1", 0)
        self.addAsyncCleanup(self.stop, server)
        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]}/v1"

    async def stop(self, server):
        for writer in self.held:
            writer.close()
        server.close()
        await server.wait_closed()

    def client(self, url, **overrides):
        settings = SimpleNamespace(model_name="synthetic-model", model_base_url_env="SYNTHETIC_URL",
                                   model_api_key_env="SYNTHETIC_KEY", model_extra_body={},
                                   model_prices={"input": 1.0, "cached": 0.1, "output": 2.0}, model_concurrency=4,
                                   model_call_timeout_s=1, model_first_call_timeout_s=1, model_retries=2)
        for name, value in overrides.items():
            setattr(settings, name, value)
        self.bus = Bus()
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"SYNTHETIC_URL": url, "SYNTHETIC_KEY": "synthetic-key"}):
            return ModelClient(settings, self.bus)

    async def test_a_silent_call_is_abandoned_and_sent_again(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(silent_requests=1))
        started = time.monotonic()

        reply = await model.complete("worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}])

        self.assertEqual(reply.content, "synthetic answer")
        self.assertEqual(self.requests, 2)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 8)
        retries = [data for kind, _, data in self.bus.events if kind == "model_retry"]
        self.assertEqual([(r["attempt"], r["of"]) for r in retries], [(1, 3)])
        [call] = [data for kind, _, data in self.bus.events if kind == "model_call"]
        # 600 fresh input, 400 cached, 100 output at the configured prices per million tokens
        self.assertAlmostEqual(call["cost"], (600 * 1.0 + 400 * 0.1 + 100 * 2.0) / 1e6)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.total_cost, call["cost"])

    async def test_an_endpoint_that_never_answers_fails_within_the_bound(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(silent_requests=99), model_retries=1)
        started = time.monotonic()

        with self.assertRaises(Exception):
            await model.complete("worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}])

        self.assertEqual(self.requests, 2)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 8)
        self.assertEqual(len([1 for kind, _, _ in self.bus.events if kind == "model_retry"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(model.total_cost, 0.0)

    async def test_a_cut_off_answer_is_asked_again_with_a_larger_allowance_and_both_are_priced(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(silent_requests=0, cut_off_requests=1))

        reply = await model.complete("worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}], max_tokens=800)

        self.assertEqual(reply.content, "synthetic answer")
        self.assertEqual(self.allowances, [800, 1600])
        calls = [data for kind, _, data in self.bus.events if kind == "model_call"]
        self.assertEqual([call["finish"] for call in calls], ["length", "stop"])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(model.total_cost, sum(call["cost"] for call in calls))
        self.assertGreater(calls[0]["cost"], 0)

    async def test_an_answer_still_cut_off_after_the_last_attempt_is_returned_as_it_is(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(silent_requests=0, cut_off_requests=99), model_retries=1)

        reply = await model.complete("worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}], max_tokens=800)

        self.assertIsNone(reply.content)
        self.assertEqual(self.allowances, [800, 1600])

    async def test_only_the_first_answer_gets_the_long_wake_up_allowance(self):
        model = self.client(await self.serve(silent_requests=0), model_first_call_timeout_s=30, model_call_timeout_s=1)
        await model.complete("worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}])
        self.assertTrue(model.answered)
        self.requests = -1  # the next request is left unanswered once

        started = time.monotonic()
        await model.complete("worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}])

        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 8)

    async def test_configured_extra_parameters_reach_the_endpoint(self):
        seen = {}
        original = ModelClient.complete

        model = self.client(await self.serve(silent_requests=0), model_extra_body={"synthetic_switch": {"mode": "plain"}})
        create = model.client.chat.completions.create

        async def recording(**kwargs):
            seen.update(kwargs)
            return await create(**kwargs)
        model.client.chat.completions.create = recording

        await original(model, "worker", [{"role": "user", "content": "synthetic question"}])

        self.assertEqual(seen["extra_body"], {"synthetic_switch": {"mode": "plain"}})
        self.assertEqual(seen["model"], "synthetic-model")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Dev-only: exercise the package's ModelClient (streaming path) against the real hosted model with the agent's
real tool definitions, several calls at once, and report what came back."""
import asyncio
import json
import os
import pathlib
import sys
import time

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
rounds = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 3
env = json.loads((HERE.parent / "scout_env.json").read_text())
os.environ.update({"QWEN_BASE_URL": env["QWEN_BASE_URL"], "QWEN_API_KEY": env["QWEN_API_KEY"]})

from rfq.agents.base import TOOLS  # noqa: E402
from rfq.config import Settings  # noqa: E402
from rfq.llm.clients import ModelClient  # noqa: E402

brief = json.loads((HERE.parent / "scouting.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["brief"]
system = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1], "rfq/llm/prompts/browser.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")


class Bus:
    def __init__(self):
        self.events = []

    def emit(self, kind, agent, data):
        self.events.append((time.monotonic(), kind, agent, data))


async def main():
    settings = Settings.from_env({"RFQ_DATA_DIR": str(HERE.parent / "runs")})
    bus = Bus()
    model = ModelClient(settings, bus)
    # A synthetic page in the snapshot format: a gate whose later controls are disabled, as a batch candidate.
    page = ("URL https://synthetic.example.test/entry\nframe/0: Synthetic notice\nSynthetic receipt: SYN-48213\n"
            "CONTROLS\n[1] range Drag fully right to unlock value=0 min=0 max=100\n[2] checkbox Confirm you are a person UNCHECKED\n"
            "[3] input Receipt number DISABLED\n[4] checkbox Conditions read UNCHECKED DISABLED\n[5] submit Continue DISABLED")

    async def one(worker, round_no):
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            reply = await model.complete(f"w{worker}", [
                {"role": "system", "content": system},
                {"role": "user", "content": "Runtime brief:\n" + brief + "\n\nYOUR TASK:\nEnter the site's working area."},
                {"role": "user", "content": f"Steps remaining: 20.\nCURRENT OBSERVATION (worker {worker}, round {round_no}):\n{page}"}], TOOLS)
        except Exception as error:
            return f"w{worker} r{round_no}: FAILED after {time.monotonic() - started:.1f}s {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:100]}"
        calls = reply.tool_calls or []
        summary = []
        for call in calls:
            try:
                args = json.loads(call.function.arguments)
                steps = args.get("actions") or [args]
                summary.append(f"{call.function.name}({len(steps)} step{'s' if len(steps) != 1 else ''}: "
                               + ",".join(str(s.get('kind')) for s in steps if isinstance(s, dict)) + ")")
            except ValueError:
                summary.append(f"{call.function.name}(INVALID JSON: {call.function.arguments[:60]!r})")
        return f"w{worker} r{round_no}: {time.monotonic() - started:5.1f}s tool_calls={summary or 'NONE'} content={(reply.content or '')[:40]!r}"

    for round_no in range(1, rounds + 1):
        for line in await asyncio.gather(*(one(w, round_no) for w in range(1, 5))):
            print(line, flush=True)
    calls = [d for _, k, _, d in bus.events if k == "model_call"]
    retries = [d for _, k, _, d in bus.events if k == "model_retry"]
    print(f"model_call events: {len(calls)}; with usage (tokens_in>0): {sum(1 for c in calls if c['tokens_in'] > 0)}; "
          f"finish reasons: {sorted({c['finish'] for c in calls})}; total cost ${model.total_cost:.4f}; "
          f"reasoning tokens: {sum(c['tokens_reasoning'] for c in calls)} of {sum(c['tokens_out'] for c in calls)} out")
    for r in retries:
        print("model_retry:", {k: r[k] for k in ("attempt", "of", "waited", "reason") if k in r})


asyncio.run(main())

import time

from ..platform import seconds_left


def deadlines(run, settings):
    duration = min(float(settings.run_budget_s), seconds_left(run) - 10)
    started = time.monotonic()
    end = started + max(0, duration)
    freeze = end - settings.submit_margin_s
    return max(started, freeze), end

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

PACKAGE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "my-agent"
sys.path.insert(0, str(PACKAGE))

from rfq.config import Settings  # noqa: E402
from rfq.submit.watchdog import deadlines  # noqa: E402


class WatchdogDeadlines(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_default_budget_is_clamped_by_configured_run_budget(self):
        settings = Settings.from_env({})
        with patch("rfq.submit.watchdog.time.monotonic", return_value=100.0), \
                patch("rfq.submit.watchdog.seconds_left", return_value=3000.0):
            freeze, end = deadlines({}, settings)

        self.assertEqual(settings.run_budget_s, 2100)
        self.assertEqual(settings.submit_margin_s, 600)
        self.assertEqual((freeze, end), (1600.0, 2200.0))

    def test_short_platform_deadline_never_freezes_before_start(self):
        settings = Settings.from_env({})
        with patch("rfq.submit.watchdog.time.monotonic", return_value=1000.0), \
                patch("rfq.submit.watchdog.seconds_left", return_value=120.0):
            freeze, end = deadlines({}, settings)

        self.assertEqual(end, 1110.0)
        self.assertEqual(freeze, 1000.0)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(freeze, 1000.0)

    def test_budget_and_margin_environment_overrides_use_external_data_dir(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            external = Path(directory) / "synthetic-run-data"
            settings = Settings.from_env({
                "RFQ_DATA_DIR": str(external),
                "RUN_BUDGET_S": "900",
                "SUBMIT_MARGIN_S": "120",
            })

        self.assertEqual(settings.data_dir, external.resolve())
        self.assertEqual(settings.run_budget_s, 900)
        self.assertEqual(settings.submit_margin_s, 120)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
